title: Godo Rakadya
intro: Ngano yekare kupfuura chero humambo kana rugwaro—dambudziko rekutanga revanhu rakazvarwa negodo. Mumwe munhu, mukuru wevana vaviri vakaberekwa nevabereki vekutanga, akatarisa nehasha munin'ina wake achigamuchira nyasha dzakarambwa. Chakatevera ndicho chisarudzo chakashata kwazvo, achisiya ropa rekutanga rakadeurwa panyika. Unogona here kuburitsa pachena hunhu, muedzo, uye kuzvidemba kunorwadza?
clues: Ndakazvarwa nevanhu vaviri vekutanga kufamba panyika.
Ndakambopa mupiro kuna Allah, asi hauna kugamuchirwa kubva kwandiri.
Chipo chemukoma wangu chakagamuchirwa, asi changu chakarambwa—chimwe chinhu chandaisagona kutsungirira.
Ndakava wekutanga kuponda panyika ino, ndichiuraya munin'ina wangu chaiye.
Allah akatuma chisikwa chepasi—shiri nhema ichichera muvhu—kuti chindidzidzise kuvanza zvandaive ndaita, uye ndakasara ndisina chimwe chinhu kunze kwekungozvidemba.

trial.label: Kutongwa/Chiitiko
options: Akarayirwa kuti munhu abayire mwanakomana wake

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Akatonga umambo husina mumwe munhu akafanana naye

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
